page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d1.6xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 24 dedicated vCPUs from an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The instance is equipped with 96.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU core.

A defining characteristic of this instance is its bundled local storage, consisting of 70,866 GB of hard disk drive (HDD) capacity. This massive local storage volume is paired with an 8 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. The instance does not include any GPU accelerators or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given the high-capacity local HDD storage and balanced compute-to-memory ratio, the ecs.d1.6xlarge is structured for storage-intensive workloads. It is suitable for large-scale data warehousing, distributed file systems, big data analytics, and cold storage applications where massive capacity is prioritized over SSD-level IOPS. The hardware profile offers qualitative cost efficiency for organizations requiring dense local storage without the premium cost of solid-state drives.
